decisions.reason: After two years as only a website mention and with an overlapping dedicated express program (D), its option value appears limited and resources are better released.
Like A, the 72-hour program remains only mentioned and overlaps with D, suggesting its results do not justify continued commitment.
Its dedicated page and focus as the main express delivery option indicate positive option value worth keeping.
The online platform is a strategic option aligned with the firm's service-oriented direction and remains valuable under uncertainty.
Its promotion from mention to dedicated page signals favorable resolution of uncertainty and justifies further commitment.
